units.source_text: ……尽管如此，我仍停下拿着扫帚的手，好几次仰望着金阁，

en.t: Even so, I stopped the hand that held the broom and looked up at the Golden Pavilion several times,

units.source_text: 我觉得在那里存在金阁简直是不可思议。

en.t: and I felt that the very existence of the Golden Pavilion there was almost unbelievable.

units.source_text: 我曾记得，一个晚上我陪伴父亲前来探访，

en.t: I remembered coming to visit one evening in my father's company,

units.source_text: 那时的金阁反而没有给我这样的感觉，

en.t: and at that time the Golden Pavilion had not made me feel this way.

units.source_text: 可是一想到今后在生活的漫长岁月里，金阁将会经常出现在我的眼前，

en.t: But when I thought that, through the long years of life ahead, the Golden Pavilion would often appear before my eyes,
it seemed truly hard to believe.
